_comment: Example/placeholder Mythic+ dungeon-timer seed for postmortem's bundled offline fallback (data/timers.json, used automatically when a live Raider.io static-data fetch wasn't attempted or didn't return anything usable -- see raiderio.resolve_timer_map). This is NOT a verified export from Raider.io's live API: neither this file's shape nor its par times have been checked against a real static-data response, because this project's dungeons (e.g. Murder Row) are fictional test content, not real WoW dungeons with a knowable real-world timer. It is hand-authored, matches the challenge_map_id values used by this repo's own test fixtures (tests/conftest.py: Murder Row = 587), and is meant to be replaced or extended with real season data -- via a live --raiderio + --expansion-id fetch, or your own --timer-data file of this same shape -- by whoever deploys this tool against a real season. See docs/avoidable_spells.example.json for the same 'we ship the format + one example, not a database' scoping applied elsewhere in this project.
